title: A heartfelt thank you to the entire Blinkit Team
review:
Today, I witnessed something truly inspiring. A Blinkit ambulance arrived quickly during a medical emergency and provided its service completely free of cost. Seeing such a fast and compassionate response reminded me how important every minute is when someone’s life is at risk.

A heartfelt thank you to the entire Blinkit team for taking this initiative. Providing emergency ambulance services without charging patients is a remarkable step toward making healthcare more accessible and saving lives. Acts like these show that businesses can create a real, positive impact on society.

Thank you, Blinkit, for putting people first. Wishing your team continued success in this life-saving mission.

title: Pathetic
review:
Very disappointing experience with Blinkit.

Their customer support is one of the worst I’ve dealt with. Instead of resolving genuine issues, they simply reject complaints without providing a satisfactory solution.

Most products are sold at MRP, so there are hardly any meaningful discounts. On top of that, they charge a handling fee, and you often have to place a large order just to qualify for free delivery.

The biggest disappointment is their after-sales service. Even when a defective or damaged product is delivered, getting a return or refund is extremely difficult.

Based on my experience, the convenience is not worth the poor customer service.

My issue remains unresolved, and I'm extremely disappointed with the lack of customer-centric support.

title: Mismanagement in delivery with no resolution
review:
Here are the details of my concern to start with:

Ordered: 6 Ciggarette packets (3 Marlboro Red/3 Classic Milds)
Refunded: 1 (Marlboro Red)
Expected delivery: 5 (2 Marlboro Red/3 Classic Mids)
Actually received: 3 (1 Marlboro Red, 2 Classic Milds
Short delivery: 2 packets (1 Marlboro Red, 1 Classic Milds)

Please note that packing 5 packets  does not establish delivery of 5, and that only 3 packets were actually received. 

I want my claim to be countered with the video evidence, if you must, as I m sure the till/packaging counter has camera coverage. I would additionaly expect an explanation from your team for misguiding me and misrepresenting the facts.

review: I worked at Niftel Communications as a Customer Support Executive for the Blinkit process. The work environment is very toxic and there is zero respect. When they want to remove you, they just stop replying to calls and messages. The biggest fraud is salary. They promised ₹16,000 for freshers but in our batch of 22 people, some got ₹1600, some got ₹400, and most got nothing. I also received only ₹1600. Blinkit team, please check your vendor Niftel. They are using Blinkit’s name to hire and exploit freshers. This will ruin Blinkit’s brand. Please take action. I do NOT recommend joining through Niftel.

title: They doing fraud
review:
Very disappointing experience with Blinkit. I never received my order, yet the app marked it as "Delivered." This is unacceptable and has caused me a lot of inconvenience. I contacted customer support, but the issue was not resolved satisfactorily.

Customers should not have to pay for orders they never receive. Marking an undelivered order as delivered seriously affects trust and confidence in the service. I hope Blinkit investigates such cases properly, improves its delivery verification process, and ensures customers are not left paying for items they never received.

Until this issue is resolved, I cannot recommend Blinkit based on my experience.
